correctness.rationale: For each n≥3 circular prism P_n=C_n□K2, encode an independent set by ternary word (0,+,−), at most one chosen vertex per rung. The unchosen rung-partner of a selected + rung sees 1 plus the number t∈{0,1,2} of adjacent − rungs; odd parity forces t∈{0,2}. The analogous − case implies any consecutive selected rungs propagate two alternating full choices around the ring, possible only for even n (coefficient a_{n,n}=2). Otherwise selected rungs are isolated and those separated by a single zero must have opposite signs; every other gap has no constraint. For 1≤k<n/2 put L=n−2k>0, r long gaps; choose their positions C(k,r), distribute L extra zeros C(L−1,r−1), assign 2^r signs to r path components; cyclic pointing yields factor n/k, exactly the displayed integer coefficient. For L=0 the two parity classes give 4 configurations iff 4|n and zero otherwise, with all other coefficients 0. Odd n maximum size (n−1)/2 has 2n witnesses; even n has exactly two full-row alternators. Independent newly written direct-neighbourhood enumeration of all 3^n ternary configurations for n=3..10 reproduced every coefficient including n=3, n≡2 mod4, and n≡0 mod4 boundaries. Initially a private test used incorrect layer encoding (-1,0,1) and was fixed BEFORE evaluation to correct states (0,1,2); rerun matched all coefficients. All-size proof is the sign-propagation and cyclic-gap argument, not finite enumeration.
